sources: Baseball Savant (xERA, xwOBA, ERA, wOBA — season to date)
MLB Stats API (K%, BB% from season stats)
ATC (projected FIP from user's Excel upload)
Fangraphs ROS DC projections — ATC DC / The BAT X / OOPSY DC / ZiPS DC (FIP)

unified_score.method: rolling-led in-season core (stabilized 0.6*L5 + 0.4*season xFIP/SIERA + xERA/botERA), blended vs projection with a DYNAMIC weight w_season = IP/(IP+K) that grows with innings (K_SP=250, K_RP=60/400); plus a small rolling K-BB% trend nudge; plus a velo+CSW LEVEL adjustment (historical-panel recalibration).

rolling_blend.note: was 0.6/0.4; recalibrated on the 2023-26 historical panel (purged CV)
